summary: Adversarially verify the combination-search result (no leakage/bug, honest multiple-comparison framing, independent re-derivation of key numbers)

verds.findings:
Audited src/novel/run_combos.py + lib.py end-to-end and re-ran the pipeline (combos.json reproduced exactly). No leakage or bug that fakes a tie or hides a win.

(1) MATH CORRECT. modality-gap: queries shifted by TRAIN-bank mean tm, gallery by its OWN corpus mean, bank by tm, all re-L2'd (a valid per-modality centering; eval/synth query means never used). DIS = QB-Norm inverted-softmax hp*S - logsumexp(hp*(Bc@gal.T),axis=0). CSLS = 2*S - rQ - rG with bank-based rG and per-query local rQ. MUL = S/pop^al popularity penalty. rerank_topn is byte-identical to published hybrid_retrieval.py.

(2) STATS PROVENANCE CLEAN. All hubness stats come from Bc@gal.T where Bc is the corrected TRAIN synthetic bank (7023 q, verified) and gal is the fixed corpus gallery. Grep-confirmed correct()/hub()/rerank_topn() never reference egt/vgt/sgt/gt. Only query-dependent term (CSLS rQ) is each query's own gallery-sim density - label-free, legitimate.

(3) HP SELECTION HONEST. All HPs (emb lam, hub hp, bm25 n/w) chosen by val MRR only (240 gallery / 717 q); eval/synth only for reporting. val-argmax is UNIQUE (top val 0.91834, only 1 within 1e-4) = exactly reported id|csls20|n50w0.2; no tie-break can swap in a better eval pipeline.

(4) GALLERIES/GT CORRECT. meta.json: 588 gallery for eval&synth, 240 val, 30 eval q, 717 val, 1706 synth. The lora384_bm25_pub reference ranks align ROW-FOR-ROW with eval_queries.jsonl (identical product_ids AND query texts in order) -> paired sign test valid. pub reproduces MRR 0.756.

NO REAL WIN, and finding is if anything generous: (a) 0/950 pipelines significantly beat pub on human-30 (sign_p<0.05); even the EVAL-ORACLE cherry-pick tops out at faithful MRR 0.762, +0.006, sign_p 0.549, CI95 [-0.079,+0.107] = tie. (b) An expanded but equally-reasonable honest grid (2604 cfgs; adds n=10, mgap0.1, csls30) selects a val-best scoring eval 0.728 - BELOW pub 0.756 - so the 0.760 'tie' is fragile to grid choice, not a robust win. (c) synth mgap+CSLS wins are real (Wilcoxon ~1e-11) but tiny (~+0.010) and those exact configs score 0.719-0.736 on human-30; with n=1706 all 84 positive-delta synth pipelines pass the sign test - a small-effect/large-n artifact, not leakage. The claim 'no combination significantly beats current best on gold eval' is well-supported.

Relevant files: /root/code/jolnon/src/novel/run_combos.py, /root/code/jolnon/src/novel/lib.py, /root/code/jolnon/output/novel/combos.json, /root/code/jolnon/output/eval_hybrid_rerank_top10_015bm25_detail.json, /root/code/jolnon/data/novel_cache/meta.json.

VERDICT: All three statistical claims in combos.json are correct and the honest conclusion ("no combo significantly beats current best on gold eval") holds. I independently reproduced every number from src/novel/run_combos.py and src/novel/lib.py.

(1) TIE vs published 0.756 — CORRECT. Published MRR=0.756 recomputed exactly from output/eval_hybrid_rerank_top10_015bm25_detail.json ranks [378,1,3,...]; data/novel_cache/refs.json 'lora384_bm25_pub' matches the detail-json byte-for-byte. Val-best pipeline reproduced: cfg=id0.0|csls20|bm25 n50w0.2, val MRR 0.9183, eval MRR 0.7602. Paired sign test on per-query reciprocal ranks vs published: mean delta +0.0042, 5 wins/3 losses/22 ties, exact two-sided binomial p=0.7266. Genuine TIE. JSON entry [0.0042,0.727,5,3] is right. The 22 ties are shared rank-1 queries, correctly handled by binomtest on nonzero diffs. Synth tie vs dense+BM25 repro also confirmed: delta +0.0033, 69/62, p=0.60.

(2) Synth significance of modality_gap+CSLS (p=0) — REAL, not a multiple-comparison artifact. mgap0.2+csls20+bm25 n50w0.25 vs dense+BM25 repro on synth-1706: 111 wins/44 losses/1551 ties, mean delta +0.01045, paired-bootstrap 95% CI [+0.0061,+0.0149] (excludes 0). The 'p=0.0' in JSON is just rounding of a genuinely tiny p: exact binomial p=7.28e-8, Wilcoxon signed-rank p=4.82e-8. Survives Bonferroni over all 950 pipelines trivially (7e-8 x 950 = 7e-5). Selection is on validation so synth is not selected-on for the reported val-best, so no inflation in the headline number. Searching the grid does NOT inflate this particular effect.

(3) Synth deltas <0.011 MRR characterized as tiny — CORRECT. Max synth delta +0.01045 on a 0.9026 base (~1.2% relative); significant only because N=1706 shrinks variance; 1551/1706 queries are ties. "Statistically significant but practically negligible" is the honest read.

DECISIVE multiple-comparison check on the GOLD eval (human-30), all 950 pipelines: 25 have raw point-estimate eval MRR>0.756, oracle-best is only 0.7628 (mgap0.4+dis10+bm25 n50w0.05), but ZERO pipelines significantly beat published on the paired sign test (0 with p<0.05 & delta>0). The modality-gap combos that win on synth LOSE on human-30 (0.719-0.736 < 0.756, sign_p 0.75-1.0) and validation does not select them — it selects id|csls20 which ties. The 30-query eval is underpowered; the search cannot manufacture a defensible gold-eval win.

CORRECTION to the task brief: the grid is 950 pipelines, not 550 (5 EMB x 10 HUB x 19 BM25-options = 5x10x(1+2x9)). This makes the multiple-comparison concern slightly larger in count but does not change any conclusion.

Files: output/novel/combos.json (claims verified), src/novel/run_combos.py (sweep, reproduced), src/novel/lib.py (paired_compare/ranks_of/metrics confirmed sound), output/eval_hybrid_rerank_top10_015bm25_detail.json (published 0.756 source), data/novel_cache/refs.json (stored ranks match).

verds.aspect: Independent re-derivation of combos.json claims: val-selected CSLS+BM25 on human-30, and the modality_gap+CSLS+BM25 synth win.
verds.findings:
I wrote src/novel/verify_combo.py (independent: re-implements CSLS and modality-gap math from scratch, does NOT read combos.json) and ran it (unset LS_COLORS; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0). Output at /root/code/jolnon/output/novel/verify_combo.json. Every reported number reproduces exactly.

(a) PUBLISHED current-best, recomputed from the rank field of output/eval_hybrid_rerank_top10_015bm25_detail.json (30 queries): MRR=0.7560, R@1=0.700, R@5=0.833, R@10=0.900. Confirms the 0.756 figure. Ranks dominated by 1s with three catastrophic misses (378, 191, 483).

LoRA cosine refs: human-30 MRR=0.6842 (matches 0.684), synth MRR=0.5684 (matches 0.568). dense+BM25 repro (val-selected n50_w0.2): human-30=0.7212, synth=0.9026 (matches the 0.9026 repro).

(b) CSLS(k=20)+BM25(n50,w0.2) on lora384:
 - human-30 MRR=0.7602 (ci [0.620,0.890]), R@1=0.700, R@10=0.867.
 - synth MRR=0.9059 (ci [0.893,0.918]), R@1=0.878.
 - vs PUBLISHED on human-30: delta=+0.0042, sign_test_p=0.727 (wins5/losses3/ties22) -> TIE. Confirms "0.760 vs 0.756, +0.004, p=0.73 tie".
 - vs LoRA cosine human-30: delta=+0.0761, sign_p=0.146 (NS). vs LoRA cosine synth: delta=+0.338, sign_p~0 (huge, expected).
 - vs dense+BM25 repro on synth: delta=+0.0033, sign_p=0.600 -> TIE. Confirms "synth +0.003, p=0.60 tie".

(c) modality_gap(0.3)+CSLS(k10)+BM25(n50,w0.25) on lora384:
 - human-30 MRR=0.7359 (below published 0.756). vs PUBLISHED: delta=-0.0201, sign_p=0.754 -> not a win (in fact below). Confirms the 0.728-0.736 human-30 range.
 - synth MRR=0.9121, R@1=0.886. vs dense+BM25 repro on synth: delta=+0.0095, sign_test_p=3.2e-5 (wins106/losses53). Confirms "synth +~0.010, p=0" — but this is a synth-only effect; the same pipeline LOSES on the gold human-30 eval, and is NOT what validation selects.

Adversarial cross-checks: (1) Re-ran the full 950-pipeline val sweep; honest val-only selection genuinely picks (id, csls20, n50, w0.2) as #1 — the reported pipeline is not cherry-picked on gold. (2) Scanned ALL 950 pipelines on human-30: ZERO beat published with sign_test_p<0.05. (3) The ORACLE best human-30 MRR over all pipelines (ignoring val = cheating) is only 0.7628 (mgap0.4+dis10+n50w0.05), delta +0.0068 vs published, still within noise.

CONCLUSION: The report is accurate and honestly stated. With honest val-only selection, the best combination ties (does not significantly beat) the published current best on the human-30 gold eval; the apparent synth win from stacking modality-gap does not transfer to the gold eval and is not val-selected. No real win exists.

final.corrected_numbers: Grid size: the task brief implies ~550 pipelines but the actual sweep is 950 (5 EMB x 10 HUB x (1 no-BM25 + 2 BM_N x 9 BM_W) = 5x10x19); verifier #2 already corrected this and I reproduced exactly 950. Minor boundary discrepancy: I independently count 24 pipelines with point-estimate eval MRR strictly above published (0.7560); verifier #2 reported 25. This is an off-by-one at the threshold and changes no conclusion. All headline numbers reproduce exactly: published 0.7560; val-best id|csls20|n50w0.2 eval 0.7602 (delta +0.0042, sign_p 0.727); synth 0.9059 (vs dense+BM25 +0.0033, p 0.60); oracle-best eval 0.7628 (delta +0.0068, sign_p 1.0); synth mgap+CSLS win +0.01045 (binom p 7.28e-8).
final.final_combo_verdict: The honest conclusion holds: no combination significantly beats the current best on the gold human-30 eval. I reproduced combos.json byte-for-byte and ran the decisive multiple-comparison sweep myself — of all 950 pipelines, ZERO beat published (MRR 0.756) with a paired sign-test p<0.05 and positive delta; even the eval-cheating oracle tops out at 0.7628 (delta +0.0068, sign_p 1.0, CI95 [-0.077,+0.108]), a tie. The val-selected pipeline (CSLS k20 + BM25 n50 w0.2) is a genuine unique val-argmax (gap 0.00056 to runner-up) and ties published on human-30 (+0.0042, p 0.727) and ties dense+BM25 on synth (+0.0033, p 0.60). The only real, statistically-significant effect — stacking modality_gap+CSLS on the 1706-query synth eval (+0.01045, Bonferroni-safe at 7e-5) — does not transfer: those exact configs score 0.7276-0.736 on the gold eval (below 0.756) and validation does not select them. No real win.
final.bugs_or_caveats: No bugs or leakage found. Pipeline math (modality-gap centering, QB-Norm DIS, CSLS, MUL popularity penalty, candidate-preserving rerank_topn) re-derived and matches; all hubness stats come from the corrected TRAIN synthetic bank and fixed gallery, never from eval/synth GT; all HPs selected on validation only. Caveats on robustness, not correctness: (1) the human-30 'tie' rests on an n=30 eval that is badly underpowered (22 of 30 queries share rank-1; CI95 [-0.044,+0.053]) — it cannot detect a small real improvement OR refute one, so 'tie' means 'indistinguishable,' not 'equal.' (2) The 0.760 headline is fragile to grid choice: verifier #1 notes an equally-reasonable expanded grid (adding n=10, mgap0.1, csls30) selects a val-best scoring only 0.728 on human-30, so the tie is grid-dependent, not a robust property. (3) The synth significance is a small-effect/large-n artifact (1551/1706 queries are ties); 'statistically significant but practically negligible' is the honest read. (4) Minor off-by-one in the point-above-published count (24 vs reported 25), immaterial.
